app_store.name: Foldesk
app_store.subtitle: Local desk for chats
app_store.promotional_text: Cards, reminders, and a morning digest on one desk. Mass sending stays out.
app_store.description:
Foldesk is a local desk for one person who sells in their own Telegram chats.

Connect your account. Open a chat, keep a card, set a reminder. In the morning the bot sends that day's summary.

What is different:
- No mass sending and no account warmup
- Your own chat folders land on cards. Groups and channels stay out
- A forward to the bot becomes a card and a note
- An empty morning is written as empty

The price of entry, not the pitch:
- A list of private chats
- A status on the card
- A note next to the thread

The desk is in Russian.

One account stays at no charge. The operator plan is $12 a month, or $120 a year. A workshop of up to three people is $29 a month, or $290 a year. When billing exists, cancel is one click and the renewal email names the date and the amount. Billing is not switched on.
app_store.whats_new: Connect your account, keep a card, and read the morning summary in the bot.
